title: CS50x: Introduction to Computer Science
description: An intellectual introduction to computer science and programming. Teaches students how to think algorithmically and solve problems efficiently using C, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Features interactive Cloud IDE problem sets with automated grading.

modules.title: Week 1: C Syntax, Data Types & Memory
Week 5: Data Structures, Linked Lists & Hash Tables
Week 8: HTML, CSS & JavaScript Web Basics

title: Responsive Web Design Certification
description: Learn HTML for structure and CSS for styling. Build responsive websites that look beautiful on mobile, tablet, and desktop screens with modern Flexbox and CSS Grid layouts, ending with 5 real-world certification projects.

title: Introduction to Computer Science and Programming in Python
description: MIT's flagship introduction to computational problem solving. Focuses on Python, branching, iteration, functions, tuples, lists, object-oriented programming, algorithmic complexity, and numerical computation with complete lecture videos and problem sets.

modules.title: Lecture 3: String Manipulation, Guess and Check, Approximations

title: Full Stack Open 2024
description: University of Helsinki's premier full-stack web course. Deep dive into React, Redux, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, TypeScript, GraphQL, Docker containerization, and automated CI/CD deployment pipelines with free ECTS university credits.

modules.title: Part 2: Communicating with Server & REST APIs
Part 3: Programming a Server with NodeJS and Express

Part 7: React Router, Custom Hooks, Styling
Part 8: GraphQL Client and Apollo Server

title: Linear Algebra
description: Comprehensive intuitive masterclass on linear algebra, vectors, dot products, cross products, matrix transformations, coordinate spaces, and eigenvalues. Essential mathematical foundation for 3D graphics, machine learning, and quantum computing.

modules.title: Unit 3: Inverse Matrices and Column Spaces
Unit 5: Dot Products and Cross Products
Unit 6: Alternate Coordinate Systems & Basis Change

title: Introduction to Algorithms
description: Rigorous introduction to mathematical modeling of computational problems and efficient algorithm design. Covers divide and conquer, dynamic programming, hashing, binary search trees, priority queues, and graph search.

modules.title: Lecture 2: Data Structures and Dynamic Arrays
Lecture 5: Binary Search Trees & AVL Trees

title: Intro to Machine Learning
description: Learn the core ideas in machine learning and build your first models using Python and scikit-learn. Work directly inside interactive cloud notebooks with automatic validation and earn a verified Kaggle certificate.

modules.title: Lesson 1: How Models Work & Decision Trees
Lesson 2: Basic Data Exploration with Pandas
Lesson 3: Your First Machine Learning Model
Lesson 4: Model Validation & Mean Absolute Error
Lesson 7: Submit to First Machine Learning Competition

title: Neural Networks and Deep Learning
description: Taught by AI pioneer Andrew Ng. Understand the foundations of deep learning, build vectorized neural networks from scratch in Python, compute forward and backpropagation, and analyze parameter tuning (100% free via Coursera audit track).

modules.title: Week 2: Neural Networks Basics & Vectorized Logistic Regression
Week 3: Shallow Neural Networks & Activation Functions
Week 4: Deep Neural Networks & Hyperparameter Tuning

title: Foundations Course
description: The open-source community curriculum that takes you from complete beginner to capable developer. Learn command line ergonomics, Git/GitHub version control, HTML structure, modern CSS Flexbox, and JavaScript basics through hands-on project creation.

modules.title: Module 1: How this Course Works & Installation Setup
Module 2: Command Line Basics & Terminal Navigation
Module 5: CSS Foundations & The Box Model
Module 6: Modern Flexbox & Project: Landing Page

title: Python Essentials 1
description: In partnership with the OpenEDG Python Institute, learn foundational programming concepts, data types, Boolean logic, conditional loops, functions, and list operations in an interactive browser sandbox with a verifiable Cisco digital badge.

Module 5: Final Course Test & Certification Assessment

title: Introduction to Generative AI Learning Path
description: Introductory level microlearning course aimed at explaining what Generative AI is, how it is used, how it differs from traditional machine learning, and Google Cloud tools to help you develop your own GenAI applications. Includes free verifiable badge.

modules.title: Course 2: Introduction to Large Language Models
